title: The Codex and Claude turn drivers give up on a dialog they know after three quick answers
foundBy: session agent, reading a failed agent replay in a local smoke run
details:
cs-codex-turn and cs-claude-turn answer a one-time dialog they know with its key. They try three times, a second apart, then fail the turn as one that needs a person. A TUI ignores keys that arrive before it takes input, and on a busy host that can be several seconds after the dialog is drawn.

On 2026-09-28 the codex-openai-lent replay of a local smoke run failed this way. The screen still showed Codex's newer-model offer, with its first option selected. The same case passed in the next run.
